data_availability_text: DATA AVAILABILITY STATEMENTAll results are included in the main text or in the supplementary materials of the present manuscript. The raw whole genome sequencing, metabolomics and biomarker data can be shared with qualified investigators using the request form available here: https://cumc.co1.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_dmck0uV3A91pmzb. The WGS data are also available via the Alzheimer's Disease Sequencing Project: https://dss.niagads.org/datasets/ng00067/. Code from this study is made available on GitHub: https://github.com/jaclyn‐eissman/Metabolome‐Wide‐QTL‐Analysis.
